{{Top|leg}}
The '''Triad Sea''' was one of four major bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. It was bordered by the [[Northern Continent]], [[Central Wasteland]], and [[Southern Wasteland]], and had all three [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]&mdash;[[Northern Ocean]], [[Central Ocean]], and [[Southern Ocean (Kathol)|Southern Ocean]]&mdash;flowing into it.
